items.text: In government, its head of government ordered an end to collective bargaining at about 40 national agencies and agency units.
In government, its head of government ordered national agencies to repeal at least ten existing rules for each new rule they issue.

Its national platform, adopted before this period, pledges to make the expiring tax cuts permanent, end taxes on tips, and cut regulations. In this period it enacted versions of the first two in the budget law, the second as a temporary deduction.
